thread.title: Close Update: Stocks Swoon as Technology Sector Leads Market Lower to Start Holiday Shortened Week

author: MT Newswires
title: Close Update: Stocks Swoon as Technology Sector Leads Market Lower to Start Holiday Shortened Week
text:
Shutterstock photo Stocks closed sharply lower as a sell-off in technology stocks helped drag the major market averages lower to start the holiday-shortened trading week in the US.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index was the biggest loser Monday among the major stock indexes, falling 3%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 suffered more modest declines. Apple ( AAPL ), Boeing ( BA ) and Microsoft ( MSFT ) were notable drags on the Dow.
Apple slumped about 4% after the Wall Street Journal reported the tech giant cut production orders for its three recently released iPhone models because of weaker-than-expected demand. Facebook ( FB ), Amazon.com ( AMZN ) and Alphabet (GOOG) also tumbled, helping sour the market's mood.
In economic news, housing data released Monday was soft. The National Association of Home Builders/Wells Fargo Housing Market Index tumbled to the lowest level in more than two years with November's index dropping to a reading of 60, the lowest since August 2016.
Concern over the impact of the continuing trade war between the US and China also weighed on the market.
The US stock market is closed Thursday for the Thanksgiving holiday.
